{{Quote|As a veteran TIE pilot, I understand that the Rebellion is a vile movement against the true government, but in all honesty I have to respect the aggressiveness and ability of its pilots. Though most of them have not been formally trained, their experience in battle has more than made up for it.|Flight Leader [[Trel Skutu]]|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Rebel pilots''' flew [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], and atmospheric [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles for the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Like the rest of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] (and unlike the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]), they came from a wide variety of [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and backgrounds. Some were defectors trained at one of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academies]], while others were former [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], or independent traders, or bush pilots from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
[[File:Xexto-SoT.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] Rebel pilot]]
The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were the individuals who flew the craft used by the Rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were part of the struggle since the beginning, when the [[Corellian Treaty]] was signed in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], giving the dignitary [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] the role of [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]]. After [[Operation Domino]] failed, pilots and their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] became the primary fighting force of the nascent Rebellion. The [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] fell under the command of then-[[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], who led his forces to victory in several battles, although the Corps retained control of pilots on special assignment with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Most pilots were part of the Rebel Alliance's individual [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]]. The Alliance Fleet under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] was originally given priority until the Fleet took heavy losses at the [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh|Battle of Tingel Deepspace Besh]], leaving the starfighter pilots as the primary fighting force.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

Rebel pilots also joined with ground assaults to support other [[Alliance Military/Legends|military forces]] and provide fire support using [[CR-1 blaster cannon/Legends|CR-1 blaster cannons]].<ref name="BF I guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> During space battles, pilots boarded enemy starships to conduct sabotage operations alongside [[Rebel Marine|marines]].<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

With the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the pilots were folded into the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]].<ref name="EG Warfare" />

==Organization==
===Training===
Training fell under the auspices of the Starfighter Command.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Veteran pilots flew with rookies to hone their skills.<ref name="SW:RA II">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref> Pilots were also trained using simulators on-board Rebel starships such as the [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. Pilots sometimes created impromptu [[Pilot proving grounds|training runs]] through factories such as [[Salvage Yard]]. Admiral Ackbar commented that after going through those unsanctioned runs, pilots came out better-skilled.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> Although not as well trained as Imperial pilots, Rebel pilots were dedicated and resolved, which helped them survive.<ref name="BF I guide" /> They were also able to develop nerves of steel and sharp eyes, allowing them to spot enemy contacts at long ranges. To them, fast speeds and the thrill of the chase are alluring, but the best master those elements.<ref name="GG 1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>

===Equipment===
Rebel pilots wore orange, gray, green or red [[Rebel flight suit|flight suits]].<ref name="SWE6">{{Film|VI}}</ref> They wore a flak vest with a life support box on top. They each also wore a [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]] which included a visor with a special computer projection for targeting. The helmets were usually decorated with the [[Alliance Starbird]],<ref name="EG Warfare" /> though some pilots customized them to include symbols of personal significance or emblems of specific squadrons. Their craft's [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems negated the need for a self-contained helmet such as those used by the Empire's [[TIE pilot]]s.<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> For ground assaults, pilots carried CR-1 blaster cannons with a backup [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|sidearm]], [[F-187 fusioncutter]]s to provide repairs, and [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] and ammunition dispensers to support [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] units.<ref name="BF I guide" /> For space-based sabotage operations, pilots carried sidearms and [[TB-47 time bomb]]s.<ref name="BF II" />

[[File:Yavin_base_briefing_room.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebel pilots assemble in the retrofitted briefing room within the ancient [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temple]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]]]

[[File:SullustanPilot-SWGTCGSoC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] rebel pilot in an X-wing starfighter cockpit]]

==Behind the scenes==
The helmets worn by Alliance X-wing pilots were made from modified plastic copies of real [[Wikipedia:US Navy|US Navy]] APH-6B flight helmets.<ref name="Star Wars Magazine UK 68">[[Star Wars: The Official Magazine 68|''Star Wars: The Official Magazine'' 68]]</ref>
